'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis|United Kingdom cost-of-living crisis]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Do it yourself|DIY]] retailer [[Homebase]] collapses into [[Administration (law)|administration]], threatening up to 2,000 jobs. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c624nzepd59o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Indo-Pakistani smog]]
**[[New Delhi]], [[India]], reports its 15th consecutive day with a "very poor" recorded [[air quality index]] due to significant [[Air pollution in Delhi|air pollution]] causing zero meter visibility [[smog]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Delhi/delhi-air-continues-to-be-in-very-poor-category-as-smog-engulfs-capital/article68862292.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*[[2024 Spanish floods]]
**Thousands of [[Spaniards]] living near river banks are evacuated following the issuing of [[State Meteorological Agency|AEMET]]'s maximum weather alert in the [[Province of Málaga]], [[Costa del Sol]], and the [[Valencian Community]] caused by a new [[cold drop]] system. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/malaga-floods-marbella-weather-spain-rain-storm-b2646451.html (''The Independent'')]
*Twelve people are killed and five others injured after a truck, bus and three cars collided in [[Port Said]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20241114/4aaccaf18475417f96e32c3aa2b1e978/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] announces that [[Turkey]] has suspended all [[diplomatic relations]] with and will not develop any further relations with [[Israel]]. However, the Turkish embassy in [[Tel Aviv]], Israel, will continue to operate. Israel's [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Israel)|foreign ministry]] denies any change in its diplomatic relationship with Turkey. [https://www.jns.org/israel-denies-erdogan-claim-of-end-to-diplomatic-relations/ (JNS)] [https://www.newsweek.com/turkey-cuts-off-relations-israel-1985013 (''Newsweek'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/turkey-severs-all-relations-israel-says-erdogan (Middle East Eye)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Brasília attack]]
**Two explosions occurs near the [[Supreme Federal Court]] building and the [[Praça dos Três Poderes]] in [[Brasília]], [[Brazil]]. The perpetrator dies by [[suicide attack|suicide bombing]], being the only fatality. The [[Federal Police of Brazil|Federal Police]] announces an investigation into the explosions, while the [[Attorney General of the Union (Brazil)|Attorney General's Office]] calls the situation "an attack against the Supreme Federal Court and the [[Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|Chamber of Deputies]]". [https://g1.globo.com/df/distrito-federal/noticia/2024/11/13/praca-dos-tres-poderes-em-brasilia-e-isolada-apos-explosoes.ghtml (G1)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/13/americas/brazil-supreme-court-explosions-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Bulldozer Justice]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] rules that it is [[Constitution of India|unconstitutional]] for the [[Government of India|government]] to demolish property belonging to people suspected of crimes without a [[legal process]], a practice common in states ruled by the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/sc-bans-bulldozer-justice-calls-it-unconstitutional-drafts-norms/articleshow/115273220.cms (''The Times of India'')] [https://www.dw.com/en/india-supreme-court-bans-bulldozer-justice/a-70771474 (DW)]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in the Philippines]], [[Philippine drug war]]
**The Philippines says it is bound to help the [[International Criminal Court]] if the international court seeks custody of former President [[Rodrigo Duterte]] through [[Interpol]] over alleged crimes against humanity committed during the [[Philippine drug war]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-duterte-icc-interpol-drug-killings-71de48e00c77c70ce37cf67146a94d12 (AP)]
